item.title: 5-Star QB set to visit Alabama this month
item.description: Elijah Haven confirmed his plans to visit Alabama on Jan. 31 with Touchdown Alabama. Haven is a 2027 five-star recruit out of Dunham High School in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. item.title: Alabama offers Vigor junior LB: “They’ve been the best for a long time”
item.description: Vigor High School’s junior linebacker, Isaac McNeil reported an offer from Alabama football on Wednesday evening. McNeil is a 2027 linebacker prospect.
